plugins.name: handoff-compact
plugins.description: Every compaction (main session or sub-agent) writes a structured handover, saves it to disk, and work carries on; idle big sessions compact before the cache expires.

plugins.name: output-offload
plugins.description: Big tool results go to a file; the model gets a short Haiku digest and the path to grep, so contexts stop refilling.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Status line with this session's spend and $/hour plus all sessions' $/hour; alarms on budget, compaction churn and big Haiku contexts; /spend breakdown.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks Haiku, Sonnet or the parent's model for each subagent and new session from what the task is, and starts sessions at medium effort.

plugins.name: production-guards
plugins.description: Stops the expensive habits: full-resolution image reads on big models, renders and downloads in the foreground, sleep-and-poll loops.
